# HubSpot Academy

> > Free online training and certifications for marketing, sales, and customer service professionals using HubSpot's platform and inbound methodology.

HubSpot Academy provides comprehensive learning resources across HubSpot's product suite including Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, and Operations Hub. The platform offers free courses, certifications, webinars, and access to a network of certified trainers to help professionals master inbound marketing and HubSpot implementation.

## Key Topics

- HubSpot Certification
- HubSpot Certified Trainer
- Inbound Marketing
- HubSpot Marketing Hub
- HubSpot Sales Hub
- HubSpot Service Hub
- HubSpot CRM
- HubSpot Operations Hub
- Hubspot Implementation
- Marketing Automation
- Revenue Operations
- CRM Specialist
- Webinar
- Agency Services
- Customer Feedback Strategy

## Getting Started

- [Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service/Support Training | Enroll for Free](https://academy.hubspot.com/enroll-in-hubspot-academy): Main enrollment page for HubSpot Academy free training and certifications across marketing, sales, and customer service

## Live Webinars & Tutorials

- [Webinar EN VIVO - Estrategia de Feedback de Clientes](https://academy.hubspot.com/es/webinars/estrategia-feedback-clientes): Live webinar on customer feedback strategy and NPS measurement with HubSpot
- [Webinar EN VIVO - Canales de Comunicación Inbound](https://academy.hubspot.com/es/webinars/canales-comunicacion-inbound): Spanish live webinar on inbound communication channels and omnichannel strategy
- [Aprenda a criar relatórios personalizados na HubSpot](https://academy.hubspot.com/pt/webinars/personalized-hubspot-reports): Portuguese tutorial webinar on creating personalized HubSpot reports
- [Como criar um novo blog](https://academy.hubspot.com/pt/webinars/create-new-blog): Portuguese video tutorial on creating a new blog in HubSpot
- [Configurar rodapés e os tipos de assinaturas de e-mails de marketing](https://academy.hubspot.com/pt/webinars/subscription-preferences-and-email-footer): Portuguese tutorial on email footer and subscription preference configuration
